title: Cream Wool Coat & Fur Hat in Snow
prompt: An original young woman with soft, wavy light brown hair stands in a snowy garden. She wears a long, fit-and-flare cream wool coat with a brown fur collar and matching brown fur cuffs, and a brown fur pillbox hat. Cream knit gloves rest together at her waist. Her expression is calm and composed. Overcast winter light and a bare tree in the background. Palette of cream, chocolate brown, and snow white. Classic and vintage, in the style of a mid-century winter fashion plate.
workingNotes:
- The brown fur collar and cuffs against the cream coat are the defining contrast.
- Use 'full-length' to show the coat's flared hem.
